name: lefthook-95ce21a8-blind29-ots
instr:
# Lefthook misbehaves from hook wiring to file narrowing, without a test suite

The repository has received 29 separate undocumented edits.

This tool wires per-project hooks into a working copy and then, when one of those hooks fires, works out what has to happen and makes it happen. Nothing about the projects it is pointed at changed and nothing about the yaml declaring the work changed, yet the same projects that used to be set up and served correctly are now handled wrongly, and in several places work that should have happened is skipped or fails outright.

Setting the hooks up in a project whose yaml also declares hooks for AI assistants now stops halfway through: two of the assistant files it should generate never appear, the fingerprint it should leave behind is missing, and when a provider is dropped from the yaml the file written for that provider earlier stays behind. Doing the same wiring where one such assistant file is in place beforehand goes wrong differently — the managed entry is never merged into it and the file comes back byte for byte as the user left it — though generating that same file from nothing, when none is there, works. An assistant file whose entries sit directly under the event name rather than in groups has the same trouble when one is in place beforehand, while the one that is rewritten wholesale comes out as asked.
